instruction: I need an audio version of the music video on my desktop. Extract the audio using VLC and save it as an MP3 file named "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating audio version of music video using VLC. Evaluator checks that MP3 file exists with minimum 100KB size to ensure audio was successfully extracted.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator comprehensively validates all aspects of audio extraction task
File existence is verified at the correct path (/home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.mp3)
File format validation uses 'file' command and checks for audio-related keywords (audio, mpeg, mp3, layer iii)
Audio content is validated using ffprobe to verify actual audio streams exist (cannot be fooled by dummy files)
Minimum size threshold of 1,000,000 bytes (~1 MB) is appropriate for music video audio extraction
Duration validation ensures audio is at least 1 second (reasonable sanity check)
Getter correctly extracts file properties using robust tools (stat, file, ffprobe)
Metric logic correctly validates all properties and cannot pass with fake/invalid files
All instruction requirements are semantically verified: audio extraction from video results in valid MP3 file
